meta.title: Sole Via Entertainment — Mobile game studio · Zen Bubbles & Cap Kickers
meta.description: Sole Via Entertainment is an independent mobile game studio in Miami making Zen Bubbles and Cap Kickers — small, tactile games for iPhone and Android. Free, offline, no sign-up.

og.title: Sole Via Entertainment — Small games you can feel
og.description: Independent mobile game studio in Miami. Makers of Zen Bubbles and Cap Kickers for iPhone and Android.

brand.home_label: Sole Via Entertainment — back to top

hero.eyebrow: Independent mobile game studio · Miami, Florida
hero.lede: We turn familiar, hands-on things — a sheet of bubble wrap, a bottle cap on a tabletop — into quick, calm games for iPhone and Android. Free to play, offline, no sign-up.
hero.sheet_label: Poppable bubble wrap. Press a bubble to pop it.
hero.note: Real bubbles and pop sounds from Zen Bubbles.

games.lede: Both are free on the App Store and Google Play, play fully offline, and speak English, Portuguese and Spanish.

zen.pitch: The oddly satisfying pop of real bubble wrap, on a calm island journey. Clear a phase, watch the little bubble hop to the next one, and try to beat your best time.
zen.f1: Four island worlds — bubbles go off-grid, start drifting, then hide behind sliding shields.
zen.f2: Pop Challenge — a surprise mission with a surprise reward drops in every few hours.
zen.f3: Gear up — bombs, snowflakes and collectible bubble skins from the Shop.
zen.f4: Soft pops & haptics — calm music, and a light tap on every pop.
zen.shot1: Zen Bubbles home screen: the smiling bubble mascot on a bubble-wrap island at sunset
zen.shot2: Your journey map with the World 1 and World 2 islands
zen.shot3: Gameplay: medium bubbles on a bubble-wrap board with a bomb and a snowflake power-up
zen.shot4: Shop with bomb and time-freeze power-ups and Neon, Ocean and Sunset bubble skins

cap.pitch: The tabletop game half of Latin America grew up playing at school — futebol de tampinha — now in your pocket. Flick, don't aim: the harder the flick, the farther the cap flies.
cap.f1: Five touches a turn — thread a cap through the gap to keep possession, then shoot on the fifth.
cap.f2: Solo vs AI — beat each rival on the campaign road, from Rookie upward.
cap.f3: 2 Players & Practice — pass-and-play on one phone, or warm up with no pressure.
cap.f4: Trophy Cabinet — earn Caps by playing and unlock pitches and cap styles.
cap.aka: Known as Futebol de Tampinha in Brazil and Fútbol de Tapitas across Spanish-speaking Latin America.

cap.shot3: Solo vs AI campaign road with rewards and a mystery chest
cap.shot4: Trophy Cabinet with unlockable pitches: table, cement, night, street, beach

studio.h2: A small studio with a simple rule: respect the player’s time.
studio.p1: Sole Via Entertainment LLC is an independent studio based in Bay Harbor Islands, Miami. We design, build and publish our own games — from the first sketch to the store listing — and we keep them small on purpose: easy to learn, quick to play, satisfying to come back to.
studio.p2: Our games are free and supported by ads. That is a craft of its own, and we take it seriously: ads sit around the play, never on top of it, and nothing you need to enjoy the game is locked behind them.
studio.pr1_d: No sign-up, no email. Your records and settings stay on your device.
studio.pr2_d: On a plane, in a queue, underground — the games work without a connection.
studio.pr3_d: English, Portuguese and Spanish, in the game and on the store.
studio.pr4_d: Anonymous usage stats you can switch off in Settings, and Apple’s tracking prompt honored.
